ns2:course.label: Pro Bono Service
ns2:course.description: Course carries no academic credit, but recognizes law students who provide at least sixty hours of pro bono legal service to the community. The sixty hours of service may be performed at any time during the student's three years of law school, and must be documented through reports to the Associate Dean for Academic Affairs. 0 credit. Students may enroll only with permission of the Associate Dean for Academic Affairs. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Enrollment in the J.D. program at the College of Law.
